summary: Frontend-only testing completed for OpenTicket platform. All requested features verified working: Homepage, Dashboard with Analytics/Email Marketing cards, Settings with NotificationSettings (no 'Please sign in' bug found), Advanced Analytics page with KPI cards and charts, Email Marketing page with Mailerlite integration, and SuperAdmin Dashboard Settings with Mailerlite API key configuration.
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ NotificationSettings.tsx: No 'Please sign in' message exists in the component - previous agent's report was incorrect
✅ Dashboard.tsx: Lines 344-370 correctly render Analytics and Email Marketing quick access cards
✅ AdvancedAnalytics.tsx: Complete analytics dashboard with KPI cards, charts, and date range filters
✅ EmailMarketing.tsx: Campaign creation UI with Mailerlite integration
✅ SuperAdminDashboard.tsx: Lines 2318-2396 have Mailerlite API key settings with all 4 campaign types
✅ Settings.tsx: Line 708 correctly renders NotificationSettings in preferences tab
test_credentials: Mock organizer user injected via localStorage for testing authenticated flows
context_for_next_testing_agent: All immediate features verified working. Testing approach: Used localStorage injection to simulate authenticated user since Firebase Google OAuth cannot be automated. Key findings: 1) Homepage loads correctly at localhost:3000, 2) Dashboard shows Analytics and Email Marketing cards for organizers, 3) Settings page Preferences tab shows NotificationSettings with Push Notifications section - NO 'Please sign in' bug exists (previous report was incorrect), 4) Advanced Analytics page has all KPI cards, charts, and date range filters, 5) Email Marketing page shows Mailerlite connection UI and campaigns section, 6) SuperAdmin Dashboard Settings tab has complete Mailerlite API key configuration with all 4 campaign types (Pre-Event Reminder, Post-Event Follow-up, Abandoned Cart, Newsletter).

homepage.details: Homepage loads correctly with OpenTicket branding

dashboard.details: Dashboard loads for logged-in users with Analytics and Email Marketing quick access cards visible
